answer: Sponsor-staked admission blocks fake identities. A newcomer joins only when a sponsor locks 15 POA behind it, slashed if the newcomer runs duplicates. A meadow feeds few grazers, so one sponsor vouches for few newcomers. Reputation decays 5% each idle epoch, and the tide of checks clears dormant shells. Making 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors and 1,500 POA; an honest agent needs 15 POA once. A comet passes fast; honest rewards stay undiluted.
